import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (text numbers) and drop rows with conversion errors
    df = df.copy()
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Clean sex label variants (trim spaces, case normalisation)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # Fix flipper_length_mm out-of-range values (negative values are likely errors)
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170, 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    # Filter out rows where critical numeric columns are out of allowed ranges or missing
    df = df[(df['bill_length_mm'] >= 30) & (df['bill_length_mm'] <= 60) &
            (df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235) &
            (df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and sum body_mass_g
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum().to_dict()
    return result
